note: The two objects at nested+12C0h and nested+13B0h are bare arrays of sixty floats. Sample i is the value at x = 50*(i+1) metres, fixed by the 50.0 double at 00CE3938 that 00955A40 subtracts and divides by and that 0095F080 steps its query range with at 0095F140. The producer is 0095F080 (docs/SHIP_AI_BEARING_RATING.md): 009F2F11 fills nested+12C0h from the OWN unit with prefer_long_range = 1, 009F2FB1 fills nested+13B0h from the TARGET with 0. Both are 60 calls to the expected-damage estimate 0095EB40, so the curves are expected damage over a 20 s window against range.

validation.usn02_before_main: shots=734 hull=180 deaths=2 total_damage=18525.6; ShipAiApproach::curve_primary_00955a40 [00955a40] UNIMPLEMENTED calls=999600
validation.usn02_after: shots=734 hull=180 deaths=2 total_damage=18525.6, byte for byte the same gunnery census; the three curve placeholders are gone from the unimplemented list; summary mission ship ai standoff choices=8400 curve_refreshes=2450, and all fourteen attacking ships chose first=300.0 last=300.0
validation.why_nothing_moved: the curve rules run but their input is zero. 0095F080 called 0095EB40 147000 times (2450 refreshes x 60 samples) and every call returned at the range gate 0095EB6E, because the firepower host's unit+494h is a placeholder 0.0f and the sweep's first range is 50.0: ShipAiFirepower::unit_max_weapon_range_0494 [0095eb62] UNIMPLEMENTED calls=147000, and category_device_count is never reached. The target curve is therefore all zeros, so 00952530 answers 0.0 and the seed is 0 + 300 = 300; the own curve is samples[i] = i - 60 after 0095F080's prefer_long_range bias, so every sample is negative, 009E723C skips every step of the scan and 300.0 survives as the choice. The previous placeholder returned 0.0f from 00952530 and produced the same 300.0, which is why the census is identical.

follow_up_packets: ship_ai_firepower_device_list: the ship AI host's FirepowerBinding answers unit_max_weapon_range (unit+494h) with 0.0f, which makes 0095EB40 return at 0095EB6E for every sample and starves both curves. Until a unit's gunnery categories reach the ship AI host, the standoff scan cannot choose anything but its 300 m seed.

ship_ai_approach_scan_scale_1284: nested+1284h, the numerator of the scan's middle factor, has no producer in this process either. Even with real curves, a zero there collapses every score to zero and the scan keeps the LAST sample with a positive own value rather than the best one.
ship_ai_approach_frame_state_tail: 009F1BC0 past 009F1DBF, which owns the two 0095F080 call sites this packet had to bind in the host instead.
uncertainties: The sixty-element extent is fixed by three independent reads (00954940's 3Ch-dword fill, 00955A40's 0x3B bound and 0ECh tail load, 009523C0's 0x3C tail loop) and by the 0F0h gap between nested+12C0h and nested+13B0h. No routine in the image bounds-checks the samples themselves, so a caller that filled fewer than sixty would read stale floats.

00955A40 rounds to float three times (00955A4F, 00955A6F, 00955A98) and the projection rounds at exactly those points, but the image keeps the intermediate in an x87 80-bit register. At a sample boundary the two agree; on a value that lands within an ulp of a boundary they may pick adjacent indices.

The query blocks the two 0095F080 sites pass (nested+127Ch and nested+1238h) are not modelled: only the 20.0f window (009F2EA1) and the 30.0f ready-round horizon (009F2EB1) are set in the host, and the rest is zero. That is labelled in the host and does not change any curve rule, but it means the fill is partial even once a device list exists.
The target refill's gate, target->vtable[5Ch](5) at 009F2F3C, has no probe in this process; the presence of a target stands in for it and the substitution is recorded as unimplemented.
